```python
import narwhals as nw

# Create sample DataFrame
df = nw.from_dict({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 600, 2000]
})

# Add tier column with conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then("gold").otherwise("standard")
)

print(df)
```
